whatIs: Basecoat is a component library for Tailwind that brings shadcn/ui's style without depending on React. You use it with plain HTML and it fits backends like Flask, Rails, Laravel or Django. It offers 42 components.
It's a good fit when you render HTML on the server and want polished components without setting up a React project.
uses: Building an internal dashboard in Django or Rails with consistent tables, forms and buttons.
Prototyping a static page by loading only the stylesheet from a CDN.
Adding dropdown menus, modals and tabs to a site with server-side templates.
caveats: The npm stylesheets assume you already use Tailwind and must be loaded after its preflight so they don't override styles.
Interactive components, such as Dropdown Menu, Select or Tabs, need their JavaScript scripts.
Chart and Drawer are listed as beta, and Chart is left out of the all-in-one bundle: you have to load Chart.js separately.
pricingNote: Open source under the MIT license.
idealFor: Sites with server-rendered HTML that want shadcn/ui-style components.
